children.text: PremiumCMS is a managed platform for running many content-managed sites without sharing anything between them. Every project is provisioned from one golden build into its own isolated instance: its own worker, its own database, its own file storage, its own domain, its own email identity.

Most multi-site platforms share a database and separate tenants with rows and permissions. PremiumCMS separates them with infrastructure: a project's data lives in a database that belongs only to that project, and deleting a project destroys every resource it was issued — completely, with nothing left to bill or leak.

Agencies, studios, and vendors who hand sites to clients. Your client gets an admin login, a custom domain that never leaves their registrar, email that sends from their own address, and a frontend repository they own on GitHub. You get one codebase to maintain and a registry of every site you run.

Instances run on Cloudflare Workers with D1 and R2, email is delivered through Amazon SES, and frontends deploy through GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages — proxied onto each site's own domain by its worker.
